Executive overview

This report shows the selected tenant’s Microsoft 365 licence products, seat allocation, assigned users and subscription lifecycle information from CIPP’s reporting data. Use it to identify decisions to make before renewals and to check that access is assigned to the right people.

Seat counts are summed across products. A person with two products uses two seats in these totals. Available seats are a review opportunity, but they do not automatically represent a refundable cost.
